result.summary: Adds the `testsubmitpackage` RPC method to test-validate a single transaction or a 1-parent-1-child (1p1c) package without mutating the mempool. result.problem: Wallets and callers constructing CPFP fee-bumping packages or attempting package RBF currently lack a way to pre-flight test package acceptance without actually inserting transactions into the mempool. `testmempoolaccept` does not evaluate package feerates, while `submitpackage` mutates mempool state.
evidence: "A test-only companion to submitpackage that validates a strict 1p1c [parent, child] bundle without mutating the mempool. Intended as a wallet pre-flight check for CPFP fee-bumping packages. Enables rbf and sibling eviction evaluation, just like submitpackage." (PR description)

result.scope_notes: Most of the diff size is in test/functional/rpc_testsubmitpackage.py (+686 lines). The C++ changes are split between mempool validation plumbing in validation.cpp and the RPC handler in mempool.cpp.
result.card: Adds a new testsubmitpackage RPC command to test-validate a single transaction or a 1-parent-1-child package without mutating mempool state. Wallets constructing CPFP fee-bumps or testing replacement rules currently cannot dry-run package validation with package feerate aggregation and sibling eviction without actually submitting the transactions. The author notes this partially resolves issue #32160 to provide requested package pre-flight testing.
